ValidationRule.description: prevents creating timecards on approved timesheets
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL( Timesheet__r.Status__c , "Pending") || PRIORVALUE(Timesheet_Status__c) = "Pending" || ISPICKVAL( Timesheet__r.Status__c , "Approved") || PRIORVALUE(Timesheet_Status__c) = "Approved") && isnew() && NOT( $Permission.Edit_TImecards_Once_Approved )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot create this timecard once this weeks timesheet has been approved. Contact the delivery manager if you need to make edits.
